newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada bonds close mixed, supply weighs on market.
newsitem.headline: Canada bonds close mixed, supply weighs on market.

text.p: Canadian bonds closed mixed on Wednesday, with Canada-U.S. long bond spreads widening, as yesterday's Ontario Hydro issue and today's auction of real return bonds weighed on the market, analysts said.
"Here in Canada we've had, in my estimation, a couple of sloppy issuances," said one Toronto-based bond dealer. "That's weighing on the market."
Canada's 8.0 percent bond due 2023 fell C$0.30 to C$102.05 to yield 7.814 percent. The U.S. 30-year benchmark fell 3/32 to yield 6.98 percent.
The spread between benchmark bonds widened to 83 basis points from 81 basis points at the close of trading on Tuesday.

Early in the session on Tuesday, Ontario Hydro issued an 8.25 percent bond due June 22, 2026 worth C$500 million with RBC Dominion Securities Inc as lead manager. Some analysts said the supply was not well received by the market and weighed on prices.
The Government of Canada this afternoon auctioned off C$400 million of real return bonds due 2026. The auction produced a high yield of 4.785 percent at C$91.489.

Canadian bond prices may also have been hurt by investors taking profits on the recent narrowing in spreads between Canadian and U.S. bonds, said Michael Gregory, an economist and strategist with Lehman Brothers.
"The currency is a bit stronger. That may have been the signal for some people to say let's take some profits," said Gregory.
The Canadian dollar closed stronger on Wednesday, fueled in part by a Goldman Sachs report on Tuesday which forecast that the Canadian currency would strengthen to C$1.3300 by year end.
In other prices, the 7.0 percent of 2006 fell C$0.04 to C$97.46 to yield 7.355 percent. The U.S. 10-year benchmark fell 2/32 to yield 6.79 percent.
The spread between the two bonds widened to 57 basis points from 56 basis points at Tuesday's close.
The three-month cash bill traded at 4.02 percent against the U.S. three-month bill at 5.20 percent.
